heading: I just need some time to think it over
intent: The prospect is delaying a decision and may be hesitant to reveal their underlying concern.
aliases: I need to think about it
I want to sleep on it
I'm not ready to decide yet

scripts.script_line: Yeah, that's not a problem. What's your time frame on getting back to me in the next day or so, just to see if I'll be available for you?
scripts.prospect_response: I should have a better idea by tomorrow. Would it be okay if I got back to you then?

scripts.script_line: Well, yeah, I mean, I'm not sure if I'd be randomly available like that with my schedule. What I can do though, if it helps you, is if you have your calendar handy, I can pull up mine and have you book a specific time with me. That way you don't have to chase me down and vice versa. Would that help you if I did that?
scripts.prospect_response: Sure, that makes sense. I have my calendar here. How about tomorrow at 3 PM?

scripts.script_line: Now John, before I go, I guess, what were you wanting to go over in your mind, that way I know what questions you'll have when we talk tomorrow?
scripts.prospect_response: I guess I'm just trying to make sure this is the right decision. I'm interested, but I still have a few things I'm unsure about.

why: Helps the prospect lower their guard instead of making them defensive.
Establishes a specific follow-up timeframe or calendar commitment.
Can help uncover the underlying concern, such as money, time, or needing to consult a spouse.
A curious, non-confrontational tone may encourage the prospect to open up.
